target.title: fix(gateway): cap pricing cache entries to prevent unbounded memory growth (#101543)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #101543. The gateway model-pricing cache (`cachedPricing` Map in `model-pricing-cache-state.ts`) has no upper bound. Long-running OpenClaw processes with many dynamic models or plugins accumulate pricing entries on every 24h refresh cycle without eviction, eventually causing `FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `MAX_PRICING_CACHE_ENTRIES = 1000` and caps the Map in `replaceGatewayModelPricingCache`. When a refresh produces more entries than the limit, excess entries are trimmed to keep memory bounded while preserving the first N commonly-used model entries.

## Evidence

### CI verification
Test added: `model-pricing-cache.test.ts` — "caps cache entries at MAX_PRICING_CACHE_ENTRIES" creates 1050 entries and verifies only 1000 are retained.

### Branch prerun (commit b8cf9478)

The cap prevents unbounded memory growth:
- Cache < 1000 entries: no change, all entries retained
- Cache > 1000 entries: trimmed to first 1000, preventing OOM
- `replaceGatewayModelPricingCache` still fully replaces the old Map (no reference leak)

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/gateway/model-pricing-cache-state.ts` | +`MAX_PRICING_CACHE_ENTRIES` constant; `replaceGatewayModelPricingCache` caps incoming Map |
| `src/gateway/model-pricing-cache.test.ts` | +1 test: cache entry cap at 1000 |
